outcomeNote: A single anonymous mishna ruling in two clauses; nothing is asked, attacked or answered inside this unit.

segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ הָאִשָּׁה שֶׁמֵּת וְלָדָהּ בְּתוֹךְ מֵעֶיהָ, וּפָשְׁטָה חַיָּה אֶת יָדָהּ וְנָגְעָה בּוֹ – הַחַיָּה טְמֵאָה טוּמְאַת שִׁבְעָה, וְהָאִשָּׁה טְהוֹרָה עַד שֶׁיֵּצֵא הַוָּלָד.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» With regard to «a woman whose fetus died in her womb and» the «midwife extended her hand» into the womb «and touched» the fetus, «the midwife is» thereby rendered «impure with the seven-»day «impurity» imparted by a corpse, «and the woman» remains «ritually pure until the offspring emerges» from the womb.

moves.cueHe: האשה שמת ולדה בתוך מעיה, ופשטה חיה את ידה ונגעה בו
moves.summary: a midwife who reaches in and touches the dead fetus contracts the seven-day impurity of one who touches a corpse
the mother herself stays pure until the offspring emerges from the womb
